Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_022909.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_022909.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_022909 (

    input [7:0] cmd_type_bus,   //指令类型
    input [7:0] cmd_op_memory,  //指令操作
    input       exu_pause,


    input [31:0] exu_rs1_data,
    input [31:0] exu_rs2_data,
    input [31:0] exu_imm32,

    input  [31:0] lsu_load_data,
    output [31:0] lsu_store_addr,
    output        lsu_store_en,
    output [31:0] lsu_store_data,
    output [ 1:0] lsu_store_size,

    output        lsu_rd_valid,
    output [31:0] lsu_rd_data

);


  wire cmd_type_memory_load = cmd_type_bus[1];
  wire cmd_type_memory_store = cmd_type_bus[2];

  wire cmd_LB = cmd_type_memory_load & cmd_op_memory[7];
  wire cmd_LH = cmd_type_memory_load & cmd_op_memory[6];
  wire cmd_LW = cmd_type_memory_load & cmd_op_memory[5];
  wire cmd_LBU = cmd_type_memory_load & cmd_op_memory[4];
  wire cmd_LHU = cmd_type_memory_load & cmd_op_memory[3];
  wire cmd_SB = cmd_type_memory_store & cmd_op_memory[2];
  wire cmd_SH = cmd_type_memory_store & cmd_op_memory[1];
  wire cmd_SW = cmd_type_memory_store & cmd_op_memory[0];


  //----------------------------------------------------
  // load instruction
  //----------------------------------------------------
  assign lsu_rd_valid = cmd_LB | cmd_LH | cmd_LW | cmd_LBU | cmd_LHU;
  assign	lsu_rd_data	  =	({32{cmd_LB}}   & {{24{lsu_load_data[7]}},lsu_load_data[7:0]})
                      |	({32{cmd_LH}}   & {{16{lsu_load_data[15]}},lsu_load_data[15:0]})
                      |	({32{cmd_LW}}   & lsu_load_data)
                      |	({32{cmd_LBU}}  & {24'b0,lsu_load_data[7:0]})
                      |	({32{cmd_LHU}}  & {16'b0,lsu_load_data[15:0]});

  //----------------------------------------------------
  // store instruction
  //----------------------------------------------------
  assign lsu_store_addr = exu_rs1_data + exu_imm32;
  assign lsu_store_en = ~exu_pause & (cmd_SB | cmd_SH | cmd_SW);
  assign	lsu_store_data	=	({32{cmd_SB}} & {exu_rs2_data[7:0] ,exu_rs2_data[7:0] ,exu_rs2_data[7:0] ,exu_rs2_data[7:0]})
                        |	({32{cmd_SH}} & {exu_rs2_data[15:0],exu_rs2_data[15:0]})
                        |	({32{cmd_SW}} &  exu_rs2_data);
  assign lsu_store_size = cmd_SB ? 2'b00 : cmd_SH ? 2'b01 : cmd_SW ? 2'b10 : 2'b0;




endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name autovcoder_022909.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
